import_overrides.comment: partial = resolved but a stub, a forwarder, or not verified to work; none = not provided

d3d12x.comment: Track each interface from slot zero through its baseline or highest recorded slot, whichever is larger. Each slot counts once across GXDK editions. Done = forwarded or implemented. Partial = incomplete behavior or an existing device diagnostic binding. Observed unmapped = evidenced call site without a translation, shown in grey. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md for middleware call sites.
